name: contract-registered-test-impact
goal: Select every registered entity test when its subject changes

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A source change selected its importing consumer test but omitted the registered boundary case: selected consumer only, excluded registered case, expanded false.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: SourceGraphService.build has no registered class method case. Its existing unit-index dependency case only exercises import and contract edges, not registered test edges or impact selection.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 29a6101218b5 fails the existing class method case because the registered boundary test has no coverage edge.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Add source graph coverage edges from tracked registered test files to their active subject units.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record ae5ae8e0493b passes the unchanged method case at 953d5d7ae2 against normalized red 17cb7c53d645.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
